summary: Tested this round's CloudIVR changes through the API (pytest, 7 tests: 5 passed, 2 failed, both failures are real findings) and in the browser with Playwright. Most of it works: (1) the policy-gate pop-up no longer appears on /app, quick-call, campaigns, lookup, wallet or buy. (2) Quick IVR permission: POST /calls/quick returns 428 {permission_required, kind:'quick'}. The UI dialog's confirm button stays disabled until the box is ticked. Confirming sends the call (202, dry-run), sets quickIvrPermissionAt and writes one callPermissions record. The next Quick IVR call does not ask again. Cancelling sends no call. (3) Campaigns: the dialog appears on every create, and each confirm writes a record with the campaign name. Cancelling creates nothing and writes no record. Preview returns 503 bulk_maintenance after confirming, so no campaign is actually saved in preview. (4) Bulk lookup downloads: 'Valid only (n)' and 'All results (n)' both produce correct CSV files (header plus n rows). Valid-only is disabled when n=0. The refund summary text shows. (5) Renewals: the section lists 4 numbers. Turning auto-renew off shows a toast, the row changes to 'Ends <date>' / 'Auto-renew off', and GET /numbers returns autoRenew=false. Turning it back on restores everything. At 390px nothing overflows (scrollWidth 390). (6) Buy page: US search shows 12 results using buy-result-<i>-number. DE/FR return none in preview, as expected. NOTE: none of the seeded accounts (uxtest/alice/bob) has a legal profile, so profile_required fires before the permission check. For the API tests I created TEST_ accounts with a profile. For the UI test I gave uxtest a temporary legal profile directly in Mongo and removed it afterwards (also unset quickIvrPermissionAt and deleted every callPermissions record I created).

critical.issue: The UI and the scheduler disagree when autoRenew is missing. Renewals.js treats missing autoRenew as ON (`n.autoRenew !== false`), but phone-scheduler.js:211 only renews when `num.autoRenew` is truthy; otherwise it goes to the new 'auto-renew off → release main line + extras at expiry' branch (line 343). A line with no autoRenew field therefore shows 'Auto-renew on' in Wallet and is then released with the carrier at expiry. The preview DB has 1 such number record (out of 23). Fix: treat `autoRenew !== false` as on in the scheduler, or backfill autoRenew:true.

minor.issue: The permission check also runs on the validateOnly pre-check. When the user writes a script (Campaigns.js:320), the frontend sends validateOnly first, gets 428, shows the dialog, writes a callPermissions record, then makes the AI voice and sends the real POST, which gets 428 again. Result: the user is asked TWICE for one campaign and 2 records are logged. Fix: skip the check (or don't log) when b.validateOnly is true.

The confirmation is logged before the campaign is validated. Rejected campaigns (400 invalid_caller, invalid_leads, 503 bulk_maintenance) still leave a callPermissions record, and the user is asked again when they fix the form and resubmit. Quick IVR also sets quickIvrPermissionAt even when the call fails with 400.

campaign.numbers is always null and campaign.scheduleAt is always null. The middleware reads b.numbers / b.contactListId / b.scheduleAt, but the campaign body uses `leads` (string), `listId` and `scheduledFor`. The record never captures the size of the list or the schedule.

Email batch bmwh09az7jzm for uxtest has been 'running' since 2026-11-14 22:56 with 0 results. It looks orphaned (probably by a restart). Clicking its 'Recent bulk checks' pill clears the result panel and shows no progress, and polling does not resume.
The home banner reads 'Move +12024595976 from Starter to undefined'. PLAN_NAME[o.to] is undefined for that offer. Possibly pre-existing.

ui_bugs.issue: When the switch is on, the white knob sits outside the 32px track and covers the 'A' of 'Auto-renew on', so it reads '\uto-renew on'. Measured knob x = track.x + 32 (computed left 16px plus translate-x-4). Visible on desktop and mobile. Fix: add `left-0` to the knob span (Renewals.js:35).

integration_issues.issue: The permission dialog appears twice for one campaign (validateOnly pre-check, then the real create). See backend minor issue.

design_issues.screen: Quick IVR / campaign after cancelling the permission dialog
issues: Cancelling shows a red error note ('Confirm you have permission to call…'). This is acceptable but could be a softer hint, since the user chose to cancel.

action_items: phone-scheduler.js:211: treat a missing autoRenew as ON (`num.autoRenew !== false`) so it matches the Renewals UI, or backfill autoRenew:true. Otherwise lines shown as 'Auto-renew on' get released at expiry.
Skip the permission check (no 428, no log) for POST /campaigns with validateOnly:true, so a script-based campaign asks only once.

Log the callPermissions record only after the campaign is accepted, or at least don't re-ask after a 4xx/5xx. Record leads count (b.leads lines / b.listId) and b.scheduledFor instead of b.numbers / b.scheduleAt.
Renewals.js:35: add left-0 to the switch knob so it stays inside the track.
Handle orphaned 'running' lookup batches (mark failed or refund after a timeout), and let opening a running batch resume polling.
offers.js upgrade banner shows 'to undefined'. Check PLAN_NAME for o.to.
critical_code_review_comments: Permission middleware runs after legalProfile.callGate, so accounts without legal details never see the permission dialog. None of the seeded QA accounts (uxtest/alice/bob) has a legal profile, despite the request's assumption.
Bulk.js toCsv does not guard against CSV formula injection (values starting with = + - @), which matters for user-supplied email/number lists opened in Excel.
Renewals 'loading' returns null until any of 3 APIs respond, then rows grow as the other lists load. This is fine but can shift layout.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all flows work; toggle knob visual bug)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ accounts test_perm<ts>@example.com (2, ids 5000000000000154/155, password TestPerm#2026x) with legal profiles. Their callPermissions records were deleted; the accounts themselves remain. uxtest: temporary legalProfile set and removed, quickIvrPermissionAt unset, auto-renew on +13341112222 toggled and restored to on, the 11 callPermissions records I created were deleted. Quick IVR dry-run calls were validated only (202 preview), not dialed.
